about: NUMBER PENDING (train e96), the presentation gaps. Unit 1: a Pine hline is drawn as the level it is on both doors (bare and bound, a negative literal, one setting through the bind path, the witnessed defaults only, the neutral ink named) and graded as a band (vw-hline-written). Unit 3: a band between two levels on the existing band mechanism. Unit 2: one candle authority on both doors (coordinator ruling R1): never four lines in a candle's place, never a hidden candle without a name (F2). Every rule, broken once, must turn its rail red.
